name: CRL-40-940
summary: Bisfluoro analogue Modafinil. Sold sometimes online as a research chemical. The drug was patented in 2013. It is slightly more potent than Armodafinil.

pharmacology.text: Flmodafinil is a selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI). Its affinity (Ki) for the DAT is 4,090 nM.

uses.text: Flmodafinil (developmental code names CRL-40,940, NLS-4, JBG01-41), also known as bisfluoromodafinil and lauflumide, is a wakefulness-promoting agent related to modafinil which has been developed for treatment of a variety of different medical conditions. Aside from its development as a potential pharmaceutical drug, flmodafinil is sold online and used non-medically as a nootropic (cognitive enhancer).
